hero.title: Building Knowledge, <accent>Passing On Civilization</accent>
hero.description: PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia is building a knowledge company capable of publishing, updating, licensing, teaching, protecting, and passing on knowledge for generations. We are opening opportunities for highly dedicated leaders and professionals to join us.

footer.title: Can't Find a Position That Matches Your Expertise?
footer.body: PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia is always open to exceptional academic talent, certified manuscript editors, journal reviewers, and publishing graphic designers. Send a letter of interest and your portfolio to <email>hrd@cakranexa.com</email>.

car-mgr-publishing.title: Publishing Manager
car-mgr-publishing.tagline: Building a Knowledge Company Across Generations
car-mgr-publishing.quote: PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia is building a knowledge company capable of publishing, updating, licensing, teaching, protecting, and passing on knowledge for generations.
car-mgr-publishing.description: The Publishing Manager leads the company's publishing strategy and operations, from manuscript planning, product development, and editorial management to production, distribution, and strengthening the company's knowledge portfolio.
responsibilities: Develop a publishing strategy aligned with the company's vision.
Lead the manuscript acquisition, editorial, design, production, and distribution processes.
Develop a portfolio of books, journals, modules, and other knowledge products.
Maintain content quality, timeliness, and publishing quality standards.
Build networks with authors, editors, reviewers, academics, and strategic partners.
Lead, mentor, and develop the publishing team professionally.
requirements: Minimum bachelor's degree (S1); a master's degree (S2) in Publishing, Linguistics, Literature, Communication, Education, or a related field is preferred.
At least 5 years of experience in publishing.
At least 2 years of leadership experience at a managerial or equivalent level.
Thorough understanding of the entire publishing workflow: editorial, design, production, distribution, and marketing.
Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and team management skills.
Oriented toward quality, detail, innovation, and results.
Able to analyze the market and opportunities for developing knowledge products.
Adaptive, collaborative, and of high integrity.

car-mgr-marketing.title: Marketing Manager
car-mgr-marketing.tagline: Building markets. Strengthening the brand. Expanding the impact of knowledge.
car-mgr-marketing.quote: PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia is building a knowledge company capable of publishing, updating, licensing, teaching, protecting, and passing on knowledge for generations.
car-mgr-marketing.description: Lead omnichannel marketing strategy, the expansion of D2C and marketplace channels, partnerships with library and university institutions, and the launch of PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia's knowledge products.
responsibilities: Develop omnichannel marketing and sales strategies.
Develop D2C, marketplace, reseller, institutional, and partnership channels.
Lead digital campaigns, book launches, CRM, and performance analysis.
Build a marketing team focused on targets and brand reputation.
requirements: Bachelor's degree (S1) in Marketing, Management, Communication, or a relevant field.
At least 5 years of experience in marketing and 2 years in team leadership.
Proven track record of meeting revenue targets and managing campaign budgets.
Proficient in digital marketing, SEO, content, CRM, marketplaces, and analytics.
Strong in leadership, communication, negotiation, and networking.
Of high integrity, creative, data-driven, and interested in the knowledge industry.
Experience in publishing, edtech, or media is a plus.

car-mgr-percetakan.title: Printing Manager
car-mgr-percetakan.tagline: Leading, managing, and optimizing all printing operations to deliver quality products on time and efficiently.
car-mgr-percetakan.quote: Excellence in printing, innovation in every solution. PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia is building a knowledge company capable of publishing, updating, licensing, teaching, protecting, and passing on knowledge for generations.
car-mgr-percetakan.description: Fully responsible for controlling the print operations workflow (prepress, press, finishing), maintaining the printing press fleet, and optimizing production costs and efficiency.
responsibilities: Plan, direct, and control all printing operations.
Ensure product quality meets company standards and customer satisfaction.
Manage human resources, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and team development.
Manage budgets and production costs, and improve efficiency to meet targets.
Manage machine maintenance and ensure equipment availability and performance.
Develop work processes and implement innovations to increase productivity.
Coordinate with related departments (sales, design, prepress, warehouse, finance) to ensure smooth operations.
requirements: Minimum bachelor's degree (S1) in Industrial Engineering, Graphic Arts Engineering, Management, or a related field.
At least 5 years of experience in printing, including at least 2 years in a managerial position.
Understanding of the printing process (prepress, press, finishing) and types of printing presses.
Able to lead a team, communicate well, and focus on results.
Proficient in production planning, cost control, and quality management.
Able to work under pressure and meet targets.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and production systems (preferred).
Willing to be based at the company's operational site.
benefits: Opportunities to grow with the company
A professional and collaborative work environment
Competitive compensation based on experience and performance

car-1.title: Senior Managing Academic Editor (Law & Fiscal Affairs)
car-1.description: Edit academic monograph manuscripts in taxation, public finance, and governance law.
requirements: Minimum master's degree (S2) in Law, Taxation, or Accounting.
At least 3 years of experience as an editor of monographs or SINTA/Scopus-accredited journals.
Proficient in APA 7th edition, the Chicago Manual of Style, and digital citation tools (Zotero/Mendeley).

car-2.title: Book Production Specialist & Typographer (InDesign UNESCO B5)
car-2.description: Design interior layouts for academic books and 3D covers that meet high literary standards.
requirements: Advanced proficiency in Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
Portfolio of premium 3D book cover designs and textbook layouts of at least 200 pages.
Understanding of prepress standards for offset and digital printing on bookpaper.
car-2.emailSubject: Application for Typographer & Layout Specialist – [Your Name]

car-3.title: Academic Community & Institutional Sales Specialist
car-3.description: Build strategic collaborations with university libraries and national research institutions.
requirements: Experience building book procurement partnerships with university libraries and government agencies.
Persuasive communication skills and knowledge of the national ISBN catalog and the LKPP e-Catalog (government procurement).

car-mgr-marketing.description: Lead integrated omnichannel marketing strategy planning, D2C channel development, institutional partnerships, and knowledge product launches across all lines.

requirements: Minimum bachelor's/master's degree (S1/S2) in Law, Accounting, or Taxation
At least 2 years of experience editing scholarly books or accredited journals
Familiar with APA/Chicago citation styles and UNESCO writing standards
Highly meticulous in standard Indonesian grammar (PUEBI)
Proficient in Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator
Experienced in laying out B5/Royal-size textbooks to printing standards
An attractive portfolio of academic and fiction/non-fiction book cover designs
